summary: Audra Mae is an American singer and songwriter born February 20, 1984, in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The note describes her family link to Judy Garland, her arrival in California in 2007, and her career milestones: a publishing deal with Warner/Chappell, a performance of Bob Dylan's "Forever Young" on Sons of Anarchy, and a 2009 signing to SideOneDummy Records.
one_line: American singer-songwriter from Oklahoma City, great-grandniece of Judy Garland, with a publishing deal and a SideOneDummy Records signing.
key_facts: Audra Mae is an American singer and songwriter from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
Audra Mae was born on February 20, 1984.
Audra Mae is the great-great-niece of Judy Garland.
Audra Mae is a great granddaughter of Garland's sister Jimmie.
Audra Mae arrived in California in 2007.
After arriving in California in 2007, Audra Mae signed a publishing deal with Warner / Chappell.
Audra Mae sang Bob Dylan's "Forever Young" on the television series Sons of Anarchy.
In 2009, Audra Mae signed to the Los Angeles based indie label SideOneDummy Records.
